", "after": "data:image/webp;base64,", "glove": "data:image/webp;base64,", "grill": "data:image/webp;base64,"};
/* ---------- Site 1 · Animated Portfolio (dock nổi, thẻ ID treo, glow theo chuột) ---------- */
const CSS_P=`:root{--ac:#7c3aed;--ink:#0f0f14;--mut:#62626f;--bg:#fff;--line:rgba(15,15,20,.1);--sans:Inter,"Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;--pad:clamp(20px,5vw,72px);color-scheme:light}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.65 var(--sans)}
.topbar{position:absolute;z-index:20;top:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px var(--pad)}.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}.logo i{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-style:normal;font-size:13px}.logo small{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:11px;color:var(--mut);letter-spacing:0}
.book{padding:10px 18px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}.book:hover{border-color:var(--ac);color:var(--ac)}
.dock{position:fixed;z-index:50;bottom:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:4px;padding:8px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 14px 40px #1e0b5a22}.dock a{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:13px;color:var(--mut);font-size:17px;transition:.2s;position:relative}.dock a:hover{background:#f1ecff;color:var(--ac);transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.12)}.dock a:hover:after{content:attr(data-t);position:absolute;bottom:56px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font:600 11px var(--sans);white-space:nowrap}
section{padding:clamp(64px,8vw,104px) var(--pad)}.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:auto}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;min-height:min(860px,100vh);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;padding-top:90px;overflow:hidden;background-image:linear-gradient(#0f0f140a 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,#0f0f140a 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 56px}
.hero small.pill{display:inline-block;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:#f1ecff;color:var(--ac);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em}
h1{font:800 clamp(44px,6vw,84px)/1.02 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:18px 0}.grad{background:linear-gradient(95deg,#7c3aed,#3b82f6 70%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.lead{color:var(--mut);max-width:520px;font-size:17px}.btns{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}.soc{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:26px;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:#fff;transition:.2s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px #0f0f1426}.btn.ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line)}
.stage{position:relative;height:580px;display:grid;place-items:start center}.lan{position:absolute;top:-6px;left:50%;width:120px;height:210px;margin-left:-60px}
.badge{position:relative;margin-top:150px;width:286px;border-radius:24px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 30px 60px #3b1d9a26,0 4px 12px #0001;overflow:hidden;transform-origin:50% -140px;animation:swing 5.4s ease-in-out infinite}.badge:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes swing{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-5deg)}50%{transform:rotate(5deg)}}
.badge .head{height:150px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#7c3aed,#a78bfa 55%,#fff);display:grid;place-items:center}.badge .ph{width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 8px 20px #3b1d9a33}.badge .ph svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.badge .info{padding:14px 18px 18px;display:grid;gap:3px;text-align:center}.badge b{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}.badge .role{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 14px;margin:12px 0;text-align:left;font-size:11px;color:var(--mut)}.kv b{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:0}
.spark{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:3px;height:34px}.spark i{flex:1;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(#7c3aed,#c4b5fd);height:var(--h)}.spark i:nth-child(n+8){background:linear-gradient(#22c55e,#bbf7d0)}
.tools{overflow:hidden;border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;padding:16px 0}.tools div{display:flex;gap:10px;width:max-content;animation:mq 26s linear infinite}.tools span{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap}@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
h2{font:800 clamp(30px,4vw,52px)/1.08 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:10px 0 14px}.kick{font:700 12px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ac)}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center}.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.stat{padding:22px;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}.stat b{display:block;font:800 36px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.04em}.stat span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:34px}.bc{padding:28px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:.25s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}.bc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 40px #3b1d9a14}.bc.glow:before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;left:var(--mx,50%);top:var(--my,50%);width:220px;height:220px;margin:-110px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#3b82f6aa,#7c3aed55 50%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(24px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}.bc.glow:hover:before{opacity:1}.bc h3{font:700 20px var(--sans);margin:12px 0 6px;letter-spacing:-.02em}.bc p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}.ic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800}
.works{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:30px}.work{border-radius:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;background:#fff;transition:.25s}.work:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}.work .art{height:170px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font:800 40px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.04em}.work div.b{padding:18px}.work h3{font:700 17px var(--sans)}.work p{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.tl{margin-top:34px;border-left:2px solid #d9ccff;margin-left:8px}.tl article{position:relative;padding:0 0 30px 28px}.tl article:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-7px;top:6px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #7c3aed22}.tl em{font:700 12px var(--sans);font-style:normal;color:var(--ac);letter-spacing:.06em}.tl h3{font:700 19px var(--sans);margin:4px 0}.tl p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.edu{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:30px}.skill{display:grid;gap:5px;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.skill i{display:block;height:7px;border-radius:9px;background:#ece9f5;overflow:hidden}.skill i:after{content:"";display:block;height:100%;width:var(--w);border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7c3aed,#3b82f6)}.reveal.visible .skill i:after{animation:grow 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}@keyframes grow{from{width:0}}
.cform{display:grid;gap:12px;max-width:560px;margin-top:26px}.cform input,.cform textarea{width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);font:inherit;background:#fff}.cform input:focus,.cform textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--ac);border-color:transparent}.cform button{justify-self:start}.form-ok{color:#15803d}
.foot{padding:26px var(--pad) 100px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:900px){.hero,.about,.edu,.bento,.works{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stage{height:560px}.book{display:none}}`;
function pageP(d){const mk=m=>{const n=parseFloat(String(m[0]).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,''));const suf=String(m[0]).replace(/[0-9.,]/g,'');const pre=m[0][0]==='+'?'+':'';return `<div class="stat"><b data-count="${n}" data-suf="${esc(suf.replace(/^\+/,''))}" data-pre="${pre}">${esc(m[0])}</b><span>${esc(m[1])}</span></div>`};
return `<header class="topbar"><a class="logo" href="#top"><i>SR</i><span>Scarlett Rose<small>Product Designer</small></span></a><a class="book" href="#contact">Đặt lịch gọi ↗</a></header>
<nav class="dock" aria-label="Điều hướng">${[['#top','⌂','Home'],['#about','◐','About'],['#services','✦','What I do'],['#works','▣','Works'],['#journey','⌛','Journey'],['#education','✎','Education'],['#contact','✉','Contact']].map(x=>`<a href="${x[0]}" data-t="${x[2]}" aria-label="${x[2]}">${x[1]}</a>`).join('')}</nav>
<main><section class="hero" id="top"><div class="reveal visible"><small class="pill">${esc(d.tag)}</small><h1>Hi, I’m<br><span class="grad">Scarlett Rose</span></h1><p class="lead">${esc(d.sub)}</p><div class="btns"><a class="btn" href="#works">${esc(d.cta)} ↗</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#contact">Liên hệ</a></div><div class="soc"><span>Dribbble</span><span>GitHub</span><span>LinkedIn</span><span>Behance</span></div></div>
<div class="stage reveal visible d1"><svg class="lan" viewBox="0 0 120 210" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M40 0 58 150h14L84 0z" fill="#7c3aed" opacity=".92"/><path d="M40 0 58 150" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-dasharray="3 7"/><rect x="50" y="146" width="20" height="40" rx="6" fill="#d4d4dd"/><rect x="54" y="168" width="12" height="22" rx="4" fill="#9a9aab"/></svg>
<div class="badge"><div class="head"><div class="ph">${avatar()}</div></div><div class="info"><b>Scarlett Rose</b><span class="role">Senior Product Designer · Lumen Studio · 28 tuổi</span><div class="kv"><span>Kinh nghiệm<b>6 năm</b></span><span>Vị trí<b>TP. Hồ Chí Minh</b></span><span>Dự án<b>48 sản phẩm</b></span><span>Trạng thái<b style="color:#16a34a">● Open to work</b></span></div><div class="spark" aria-hidden="true">${[30,46,38,60,52,74,66,88,80,100].map(h=>`<i style="--h:${h}%"></i>`).join('')}</div></div></div></div></section>
<div class="tools" aria-label="Công cụ"><div>${['Figma','React','Framer Motion','TypeScript','Webflow','Blender','Notion','Figma','React','Framer Motion','TypeScript','Webflow','Blender','Notion'].map(x=>`<span>${x}</span>`).join('')}</div></div>
<section id="about"><div class="wrap about"><div class="reveal"><p class="kick">About me</p><h2>Passionate about <span class="grad">Digital Experiences.</span></h2><p class="lead">Mình bắt đầu bằng việc quan sát cách người dùng thật sự dùng sản phẩm, rồi thiết kế từng chuyển động có lý do. “Animation tốt là khi bạn không nhận ra nó, chỉ thấy mọi thứ trơn tru hơn.” — Scarlett Rose</p></div><div class="stats reveal d1">${d.metric.map(mk).join('')}</div></div></section>
<section id="services" style="background:#fafafc"><div class="wrap"><div class="reveal"><p class="kick">What I do</p><h2>Thiết kế, chuyển động, code.</h2></div><div class="bento">${[['◐','Product Design','Nghiên cứu, wireframe, design system cho app fintech và SaaS.'],['✦','Motion & Interaction','Micro-interaction, scroll story, hiệu ứng chạy 60 fps.'],['</>','Performance Optimization','React + TypeScript, Lighthouse 95+, giảm 38% thời gian tải.'],['◎','System Architecture','Design token, component có test, tài liệu cho đội 5–40 người.']].map((x,i)=>`<article class="bc glow reveal${i%2?' d1':''}"><div class="ic">${x[0]}</div><h3>${x[1]}</h3><p>${x[2]}</p></article>`).join('')}</div></div></section>
<section id="works"><div class="wrap"><div class="reveal"><p class="kick">Selected works</p><h2>Dự án nổi bật.</h2></div><div class="works">${[['Lumen Pay','Fintech · +32% chuyển đổi đăng ký','linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#3b82f6)','+32%'],['Northstar DS','Design system · 140 component','linear-gradient(135deg,#0f0f14,#4b5563)','140'],['Pixel Harbor','20+ landing page & motion','linear-gradient(135deg,#f97316,#ec4899)','20+']].map((x,i)=>`<article class="work reveal${i?' d1':''}"><div class="art" style="background:${x[2]}">${x[3]}</div><div class="b"><h3>${x[0]}</h3><p>${x[1]}</p></div></article>`).join('')}</div></div></section>
<section id="journey" style="background:#fafafc"><div class="wrap"><div class="reveal"><p class="kick">Career journey</p><h2>Sáu năm, ba nơi làm việc.</h2></div><div class="tl">${[['2024 — NAY','Senior Product Designer · Lumen Studio','Dẫn dắt thiết kế Lumen Pay, tăng chuyển đổi đăng ký 32% sau 2 quý.'],['2022 — 2024','Product Designer · Northstar Market','Xây design system 140 component dùng chung cho 6 squad.'],['2020 — 2022','UI Designer · Pixel Harbor','Thiết kế 20+ landing page và motion cho khách hàng SMB.']].map((x,i)=>`<article class="reveal${i?' d1':''}"><em>${x[0]}</em><h3>${x[1]}</h3><p>${x[2]}</p></article>`).join('')}</div></div></section>
<section id="education"><div class="wrap"><div class="reveal"><p class="kick">Academic background</p><h2>Học thuật & kỹ năng.</h2></div><div class="edu"><article class="bc glow reveal"><h3>Cử nhân Thiết kế Đồ họa</h3><p>Đại học Kiến trúc TP.HCM · 2016 — 2020 · GPA 3,6/4</p><h3 style="margin-top:20px">Chứng chỉ Google UX Design</h3><p>Coursera · 2021</p></article><article class="bc glow reveal d1">${[['Product design',94],['Motion design',88],['Frontend (React)',82],['Nghiên cứu người dùng',76]].map(x=>`<div class="skill">${x[0]} · ${x[1]}%<i style="--w:${x[1]}%"></i></div>`).join('')}</article></div></div></section>
<section id="contact" style="background:#fafafc"><div class="wrap"><div class="reveal"><p class="kick">Let’s connect</p><h2>Cùng làm điều gì đó đáng nhớ?</h2><p class="lead">Trả lời trong 24 giờ làm việc. Đây là biểu mẫu mẫu, chưa gửi dữ liệu đi đâu.</p></div><form class="cform reveal d1" data-demo-form><input type="text" placeholder="Tên của bạn" aria-label="Tên" required><input type="email" placeholder="Email" aria-label="Email" required><textarea rows="4" placeholder="Bạn đang làm dự án gì?" aria-label="Nội dung"></textarea><button class="btn" type="submit">Gửi tin nhắn ↗</button><p class="form-ok">Cảm ơn bạn! (Bản xem trước — hãy nối biểu mẫu với dịch vụ của bạn trước khi xuất bản.)</p></form></div></section></main>
<footer class="foot"><b>${esc(d.brand)}</b><span>${esc(d.location)} · Website template preview</span><span>© 2027 · Nội dung mẫu — tùy biến trước khi xuất bản</span></footer>`}

/* ---------- Site 2 · SMASH // THE SEAR (ảnh thật từ video + HUD) ---------- */
const CSS_S=`:root{--ac:#e8c25a;--fire:#ff7a1a;--bg:#070708;--pn:#101012;--ink:#ece8df;--mut:#8d8a82;--line:rgba(236,232,223,.14);--mono:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;--cond:"Arial Narrow","Roboto Condensed",Impact,"Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;--pad:clamp(20px,5vw,72px);color-scheme:dark}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:13px/1.6 var(--mono)}
.top{position:absolute;z-index:40;top:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:18px var(--pad)}
.brand{font:900 22px var(--cond);letter-spacing:.14em;line-height:1}.brand small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font:9px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--mut)}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:20px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}.nav-links a:hover,.nav-links a.on{color:var(--ac)}
.cta{padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid var(--ac);color:var(--ac);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.2s}.cta:hover{background:var(--ac);color:#000}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:min(820px,100vh);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;padding:130px var(--pad) 130px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.hf{position:relative;justify-self:end;width:min(100%,460px)}.hf .frame img{aspect-ratio:.9;object-position:50% 35%;animation:push 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes push{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.07)}}.hf .rd{position:absolute;z-index:3;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#ece8dfaa}.hf .rd.a{top:14px;left:38px}.hf .rd.b{top:14px;right:38px;color:var(--fire)}
.smoke{position:absolute;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;left:10%;bottom:-18%;width:80%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffffff22,transparent 65%);filter:blur(28px);animation:drift 11s ease-in-out infinite}.smoke.b{left:40%;animation-delay:-5s;opacity:.7}@keyframes drift{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translate(-6%,-14%) scale(1.25)}}
.tag{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--fire)}h1{font:900 clamp(54px,7.4vw,118px)/.86 var(--cond);letter-spacing:-.01em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:18px 0 20px}h1 span{display:block;color:var(--ac)}h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--fire);margin-right:.08em}
.lead{max-width:430px;color:#b9b5ab}.btn{display:inline-block;margin-top:24px;padding:15px 28px;background:var(--ac);color:#000;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.2s}.btn:hover{background:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.scrub{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);right:var(--pad);bottom:30px;display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--mut)}.scrub .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}.scrub .row b{color:var(--ac)}.rec{color:var(--fire)}.rec:before{content:"● ";animation:blink 1.2s steps(2) infinite}@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.2}}
.ticks{height:14px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#ece8df55 0 1px,transparent 1px 12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}.ticks:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-1px;height:2px;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ac),var(--fire));transform-origin:left;animation:run 14s linear infinite}@keyframes run{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
section{padding:clamp(60px,7vw,100px) var(--pad);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.sec{font:10px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--fire);text-transform:uppercase}h2{font:900 clamp(34px,5.4vw,76px)/.95 var(--cond);text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0 16px}h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--ac)}h2 .gh{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px #ece8df66}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(24px,4vw,64px);align-items:center}.frame{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;background:#000}.frame img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.3;object-fit:cover;filter:contrast(1.08) saturate(1.1)}.frame:before,.frame:after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:2;width:22px;height:22px;border:2px solid var(--ac);top:10px;left:10px;border-right:0;border-bottom:0}.frame:after{top:auto;left:auto;right:10px;bottom:10px;border:2px solid var(--ac);border-left:0;border-top:0}.frame .cap{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:34px;bottom:14px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#ece8dfaa}
.read{display:grid;margin-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.read div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.read span{color:var(--mut)}
.nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;margin-top:34px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.num{padding:26px 20px 10px 0;border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:20px}.num:first-child{border:0;padding-left:0}.num b{display:block;font:900 clamp(64px,9vw,130px)/.95 var(--cond);color:var(--ac);text-shadow:3px 3px 0 #e8c25a33,6px 6px 0 #e8c25a14;letter-spacing:-.02em}.num b small{font-size:.4em;margin-left:4px;color:var(--fire)}.num span{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}.num p{margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;color:#b9b5ab}
.panel{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--pn);overflow:hidden}.panel svg{width:100%;height:auto}.patty{transform-origin:260px 236px;animation:smash 3.4s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.3,1) infinite}.spatula{animation:press 3.4s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.3,1) infinite}.spark{animation:spark 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes smash{0%,30%{transform:scale(1,1)}45%,70%{transform:scale(1.32,.5)}100%{transform:scale(1,1)}}@keyframes press{0%,25%{transform:translateY(0)}45%,70%{transform:translateY(94px)}100%{transform:translateY(0)}}@keyframes spark{0%,100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-14px)}}
.menu{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:32px}.item{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--pn);padding:18px;transition:.25s}.item:hover{border-color:var(--ac);transform:translateY(-4px)}.item .art{aspect-ratio:1.15;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%,#ff7a1a22,transparent 70%)}.item .art svg{width:86%}.item h3{font:800 20px var(--cond);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin:12px 0 2px}.item p{color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}.item b{display:block;margin-top:10px;color:var(--ac)}
.sauce{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:30px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(95deg,#ff7a1a,#e8c25a);color:#120a02;border:0}.sauce h2{color:#120a02}.sauce h2 em{color:#7a2a00}.sauce .sec{color:#7a2a00}.sauce p{max-width:560px;font-weight:600}.quote{font:italic 15px/1.5 var(--mono);max-width:360px;border-left:3px solid #120a02;padding-left:16px}
.slot{display:grid;gap:18px;padding:26px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--pn)}.slot label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.chips button{padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:12px var(--mono)}.chips button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ac);color:#000;border-color:var(--ac)}.stepper{display:flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);width:max-content}.stepper button{width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ac);font-size:20px}.stepper b{min-width:60px;text-align:center;font:800 22px var(--cond)}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:24px var(--pad);border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11px;color:var(--mut)}
@media(max-width:900px){.nav-links{display:none;position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:16px var(--pad);background:#07070af2}.nav-links.open{display:flex}.nav-toggle{display:block;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:none;color:var(--ink)}.top .cta{display:none}.two,.sauce{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nums,.menu{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.num:nth-child(3){border-left:0;padding-left:0}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hf{justify-self:center}}`;
function pageS(d){const m=[{id:'a',patties:1,label:'Classic Smash',n:'Classic Smash',t:'1 patty · American · pickle sauce',p:'89.000đ'},{id:'b',patties:2,label:'Double Melt',n:'Double Melt',t:'2 patty · MELTED AMERICAN',p:'119.000đ',sauce:1},{id:'c',patties:1,bacon:1,label:'Bacon Jam',n:'Bacon Jam',t:'Bacon hun khói · hành caramel',p:'109.000đ',cheese:'#ffcf4a'},{id:'d',patties:1,pickle:1,label:'Pickle Crunch',n:'Pickle Crunch',t:'Dưa chuột muối 48 giờ',p:'99.000đ',sauce:1}];
return `<header class="top"><a class="brand" href="#top">${esc(d.brand)}<small>GRIDDLE-FORGED</small></a><nav class="nav-links" aria-label="Điều hướng"><a href="#top" class="on">01 Line-up</a><a href="#smash">02 The smash</a><a href="#sear">03 The sear</a><a href="#cut">04 The cut</a><a href="#book">05 Book</a></nav><a class="cta" href="#book">${esc(d.cta)}</a><button class="nav-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Mở menu">MENU</button></header>
<section class="hero" id="top" style="border:0"><div class="reveal visible"><p class="tag">GRIDDLE-FORGED // CUT 01 // ${esc(d.location.toUpperCase())}</p><h1><em>//</em>SMASH<span>THE SEAR.</span></h1><p class="lead">${esc(d.sub)}</p><a class="btn" href="#cut">Xem menu ↗</a></div><div class="hf reveal visible d1"><div class="frame"><span class="rd a">CAM 01 · FLAT-TOP</span><span class="rd b">● REC</span><img src="${IMG.glove}" alt="Tay đeo găng đen nặn miếng thịt bò xay tươi trên flat-top bốc khói"><span class="smoke"></span><span class="smoke b"></span><span class="cap">01 · LINE-UP — 120 G FRESH-GROUND</span></div></div><div class="scrub"><div class="row"><b>01 · OVERVIEW</b><span class="rec">REC · TC 00:00:18:11</span></div><div class="ticks"></div></div></section>
<section id="smash"><div class="two"><div class="reveal"><p class="sec">// 02 · The smash</p><h2>Maillard <em>trong 8 giây.</em></h2><p class="lead" style="color:var(--mut)">Miếng thịt 120 g được nặn lỏng, thả xuống flat-top 230°C rồi ép phẳng ngay. Lớp vỏ caramel hình thành trước khi nước thịt kịp thoát ra.</p><div class="read"><div><span>Bếp trưởng</span><b>Đặng Quốc Hưng · 34 tuổi</b></div><div><span>Sản lượng</span><b>1.240 burger / cuối tuần</b></div></div></div><div class="frame reveal d1"><img src="${IMG.grill}" alt="Patty phô mai chảy trên flat-top bốc khói"><span class="cap">02 · THE SMASH — MAILLARD</span></div></div></section>
<section id="sear"><p class="sec reveal">// 03 · The sear</p><h2 class="reveal">Flat-top <em>steel sear.</em></h2><div class="nums">${[['120','G','Fresh-ground','Khối lượng patty, bò xay tươi 80/20.'],['90','S','Seconds','Thời gian ép trước khi lật.'],['230','°C','Sear temperature','Nhiệt độ mặt thép flat-top.'],['1','','Patty','Không thỏa hiệp, không gia vị thừa.']].map((x,i)=>`<div class="num reveal${i%2?' d1':''}"><b data-count="${x[0]}">${x[0]}<small>${x[1]}</small></b><span>${x[2]}</span><p>${x[3]}</p></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="panel reveal" style="margin-top:30px">${flat()}</div></section>
<section id="cut"><p class="sec reveal">// 04 · The cut</p><h2 class="reveal">Bốn burger. <em>Không thừa.</em></h2><div class="menu">${m.map((x,i)=>`<article class="item reveal${i%2?' d1':''}"><div class="art">${burger(Object.assign({},x,{id:x.id}))}</div><h3>${x.n}</h3><p>${x.t}</p><b>${x.p}</b></article>`).join('')}</div></section>
<section id="sauce" class="sauce"><div class="reveal"><p class="sec">// 05 · Smash sauce</p><h2>Sốt <em>độc quyền.</em></h2><p>Mayo trứng, mù tạt vàng, dưa chuột muối băm nhỏ và một chút ớt hun khói. Ủ lạnh 24 giờ trước khi phục vụ.</p></div><blockquote class="quote reveal d1">“Một cái burger ngon phải để lại vết dầu trên tay, không phải trên lương tâm.”<br>— Đặng Quốc Hưng, bếp trưởng</blockquote></section>
<section id="book"><div class="two"><div class="reveal"><p class="sec">// 06 · Reservation</p><h2>Giữ <em>bàn.</em></h2><p class="lead" style="color:var(--mut)">Bàn giữ 15 phút. Nhóm trên 8 người vui lòng gọi trước. Đây là bộ chọn mẫu, chưa gửi dữ liệu đi đâu.</p></div><div class="slot reveal d1"><div><label>Số khách</label><div class="stepper"><button type="button" data-step="-1" aria-label="Giảm">−</button><b data-party>2</b><button type="button" data-step="1" aria-label="Tăng">+</button></div></div><div><label>Khung giờ</label><div class="chips" data-chips data-out="[data-slot]">${['18:00','18:45','19:30','20:15'].map((t,i)=>`<button type="button" aria-pressed="${i===1}" data-price="${t}">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div></div><a class="btn" href="#top" style="text-align:center;margin:0">Xác nhận <span data-slot>18:45</span> ↗</a></div></div></section>
<footer class="foot"><b>${esc(d.brand)}</b><span>${esc(d.location)} · Website template preview</span><span>© 2027 · Nội dung mẫu — tùy biến trước khi xuất bản</span></footer>`}

/* ---------- Site 3 · Ámbar Serum (ảnh thật từ video + cảnh cuộn trước/sau) ---------- */
const CSS_A=`:root{--ac:#e8420f;--or:#f26a1b;--ink:#2a120a;--cream:#fff4ec;--mut:#8a6a5a;--line:rgba(42,18,10,.12);--sans:"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;--pad:clamp(20px,5vw,80px);color-scheme:light}
body{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.6 var(--sans)}
.nav{position:absolute;z-index:30;top:16px;left:var(--pad);right:var(--pad);display:flex;justify-content:center}.pill{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 6px 6px 22px;border-radius:99px;background:#fff3;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid #fff4;color:#fff}.brand{font:800 14px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3em;margin-right:14px}.pill a.l{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}.pill a.l:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--ac)}.pill .shop{padding:9px 20px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--ac);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;border:1px solid #fff5}.pill .shop span{margin-left:6px;opacity:.85}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:min(840px,100vh);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:110px 0 60px var(--pad);background:linear-gradient(120deg,#d63a12,#ea4f14 55%,#f06a1a);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
h1{font:800 clamp(46px,6.6vw,100px)/.97 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.045em}.hero p{max-width:420px;margin:22px 0 28px;font-size:16px;opacity:.92}.kick{font:700 11px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}.btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:15px 28px;border-radius:99px;background:#fff;color:var(--ac);font-weight:800;transition:.2s;border:0}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px #0003}.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1px solid #fff8}.btn.red{background:var(--ac);color:#fff;width:100%;font-size:16px}.btn.red:hover{background:#c8350a}
.shot-h{position:relative;align-self:stretch;min-height:420px;margin-right:0}.shot-h img{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;width:100%;height:auto;transform:translateY(-50%);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 30%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,#000 30%,#000 70%,transparent);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 30%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,#000 30%,#000 70%,transparent);mask-composite:intersect;animation:float 7s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(-50%)}50%{transform:translateY(calc(-50% - 10px))}}
.band{position:relative;min-height:440px;display:grid;align-items:center;padding:0 var(--pad);overflow:hidden;color:var(--ink)}.band img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;animation:slow 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes slow{to{transform:scale(1.08)}}.band:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff4ecee,#fff4ec55 50%,transparent)}.band .t{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:480px}
section{padding:clamp(60px,8vw,110px) var(--pad)}h2{font:800 clamp(32px,4.6vw,66px)/1.02 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.04em}.k2{font:700 12px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ac);margin-bottom:12px}
.story{position:relative;height:260vh;padding:0;--p:0;background:var(--cream)}.sticky{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px var(--pad)}.stage{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:1040px;height:min(76vh,620px);border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 80px #7a2a0030}.stage img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(1.08) contrast(1.04)}.stage .after{opacity:var(--p)}.stage:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#fff4ecdd 0,transparent 45%);pointer-events:none}
.lens{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:60%;top:42%;width:min(190px,36vw);aspect-ratio:1;margin:-95px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff9,#ffb34766 45%,#ff7a1a33);border:2px solid #fff9;box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px #fff6,0 18px 40px #7a2a0033;opacity:calc(1 - var(--p) * 2.8);transform:scale(calc(1 + var(--p) * .5))}
.cap{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:34px;bottom:30px;max-width:min(520px,80%);transition:opacity .35s,transform .35s}.cap span{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7a2a00}.cap h2{color:var(--ink)}.cap.t2{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}.story.on .t1{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-14px)}.story.on .t2{opacity:1;transform:none}
.prod{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,80px);align-items:start;max-width:1240px;margin:auto}.shot{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff,#ffe6d3);border-radius:28px;padding:40px;display:grid;place-items:center}.shot svg{width:min(280px,70%)}
.price{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin:14px 0}.price b{font:800 34px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ac)}.price s{color:var(--mut)}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:14px 0}.chips button{padding:10px 18px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-weight:700}.chips button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.tbl{margin:22px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.tbl div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.tbl span{color:var(--mut)}
.proof{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;max-width:1240px;margin:44px auto 0}.proof div{padding:26px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}.proof b{display:block;font:800 44px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--ac)}.proof span{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
.rev{max-width:1240px;margin:44px auto 0;padding:34px;border-radius:26px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:26px;align-items:center}.rev i{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f26a1b,#e8420f);display:grid;place-items:center;font:800 26px var(--sans);font-style:normal;color:#fff}.rev blockquote{margin:0;font:italic 20px/1.5 Georgia,serif}.rev small{display:block;margin-top:8px;opacity:.7;font-family:var(--sans)}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:26px var(--pad);border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
@media(max-width:900px){.pill a.l{display:none}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:100px var(--pad) 0}.shot-h{min-height:360px;margin:0 calc(var(--pad) * -1)}.prod,.proof,.rev{grid-template-columns:1fr}.story{height:220vh}.lens{left:70%}}`;
function pageA(d){return `<header class="nav"><nav class="pill" aria-label="Điều hướng"><a class="brand" href="#top">ÁMBAR</a><a class="l" href="#formula">Công thức</a><a class="l" href="#story">Vết thâm</a><a class="l" href="#proof">Kết quả</a><a class="shop" href="#product">Mua<span data-cart>0</span></a></nav></header>
<main><section class="hero" id="top"><div class="reveal visible"><p class="kick">${esc(d.tag)}</p><h1>Cam đỏ,<br>trong một giọt.</h1><p>${esc(d.sub)}</p><div class="btns"><a class="btn" href="#product">${esc(d.cta)} ↗</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#formula">Xem công thức</a></div></div><div class="shot-h reveal visible d1"><img src="${IMG.bottle}" alt="Chai serum hổ phách có ống nhỏ giọt đặt trên nền cam"></div></section>
<section class="band" id="formula" style="padding-block:0"><img src="${IMG.ripple}" alt="Giọt serum hổ phách tạo sóng lan đồng tâm"><div class="t reveal"><p class="k2">Công thức</p><h2>Hai, ba giọt.<br>Thoa đều.</h2><p style="color:var(--mut);margin-top:12px">Vitamin C 15% và Ferulic 1% trong gel mỏng, thấm trong chưa đến 30 giây.</p></div></section>
<section class="story" id="story" data-scrolly><div class="sticky"><div class="stage"><img src="${IMG.before}" alt="Da có vết thâm trước khi dùng"><img class="after" src="${IMG.after}" alt="Da đều màu sau 28 ngày"><div class="lens" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="cap t1"><span>01 · Trước khi dùng</span><h2>Vết thâm<br>cứ ở nguyên.</h2></div><div class="cap t2"><span>02 · Sau 28 ngày</span><h2>Vết mờ dần.<br>Da đều màu.</h2></div></div></div></section>
<section id="product"><div class="prod"><div class="shot reveal">${bottle('p')}</div><div class="reveal d1"><p class="k2">Ámbar Serum · 30 ml</p><h2>Ámbar <span style="color:var(--ac)">Serum</span></h2><p style="color:var(--mut);margin-top:10px">Vitamin C 15% + Ferulic 1% trong chai hổ phách chống sáng. Dùng 3–4 giọt mỗi sáng, trước kem chống nắng.</p><div class="price"><b data-price>690.000đ</b><s>790.000đ</s></div><div class="chips" data-chips data-out="[data-price]">${[['15 ml','390.000đ'],['30 ml','690.000đ'],['50 ml','990.000đ']].map((x,i)=>`<button type="button" aria-pressed="${i===1}" data-price="${x[1]}">${x[0]}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="tbl">${[['Hoạt chất','L-Ascorbic Acid 15% · Ferulic 1%'],['pH','3,2 (ổn định 12 tháng)'],['Kết cấu','Dạng gel mỏng, không dính'],['Phù hợp','Da thâm nám, xỉn màu, da dầu & hỗn hợp']].map(x=>`<div><span>${x[0]}</span><b>${x[1]}</b></div>`).join('')}</div><button class="btn red" type="button" data-add>Thêm vào giỏ ↗</button></div></div></section>
<section id="proof" style="padding-top:0"><div class="proof">${[['92','%','Thấy da đều màu sau 28 ngày'],['124','','Người tham gia thử nghiệm nhỏ'],['3','–4','Giọt mỗi sáng là đủ']].map(x=>`<div class="reveal"><b data-count="${x[0]}" data-suf="${x[1]}">${x[0]}${x[1]}</b><span>${x[2]}</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rev reveal"><i>HA</i><div><blockquote>“Tôi chỉ đưa vào công thức những gì da thật sự cần: đủ hoạt chất, đúng pH và một chai không để ánh sáng phá hỏng nó.”</blockquote><small>BS. Phạm Thu Hà, 39 tuổi · Bác sĩ da liễu, đồng phát triển công thức</small></div></div></section></main>
<footer class="foot"><b>${esc(d.brand)}</b><span>${esc(d.location)} · Website template preview</span><span>© 2027 · Nội dung mẫu — tùy biến trước khi xuất bản</span></footer>`}

/* ---------- Build + đăng ký vào luồng sẵn có ---------- */
const PAGES={'scarlett-portfolio':[pageP,CSS_P,'#7c3aed'],'smash-burger':[pageS,CSS_S,'#0b0b0c'],'ambar-serum':[pageA,CSS_A,'#ff4a14']};
function build(id){const p=PAGES[id],d=REF[id];if(!p||!d)return '';
 return '<!doctype html><html lang="vi"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>'+esc(d.brand)+' — '+esc(d.title.replace(/\n/g,' '))+'</title><meta name="description" content="'+esc(d.sub.slice(0,155))+'"><meta name="theme-color" content="'+p[2]+'"><style>'+BASE+p[1]+'</style></head><body><div class="progress"></div>'+p[0](d)+'<scr'+'ipt>'+JS+'</scr'+'ipt></body></html>'}
function brief(id){const d=REF[id];return [d.brand,d.tag,d.title.replace(/\n/g,' '),d.sub,'Thông điệp: '+d.cta,'Địa điểm: '+d.location,'Dữ liệu mẫu: '+d.metric.map(x=>x.join(' ')).join(' · ')].join('\n')}

/* 1) Chuỗi hoá K.buildFromSpec (thumbnail + Auto Design + xuất bản đều đi qua đây) */
const prev=K.buildFromSpec;
K.buildFromSpec=function(spec){if(spec&&spec.siteTemplate&&REF[spec.siteTemplate])return build(spec.siteTemplate);return prev.apply(this,arguments)};

const CSS_P=`:root{--ink:#0b0b12;--mut:#6b7280;--line:#eceef3;--v:#7c3aed;--b:#3b82f6;--g:linear-gradient(90deg,#7c3aed,#4f7cff 70%,#38bdf8)}
body{font-family:"Inter","SF Pro Display","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;background-image:radial-gradient(#e6e8f0 1px,transparent 1.2px);background-size:22px 22px;overflow-x:hidden}
.gt{background:var(--g);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.nav{position:fixed;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:50;width:min(760px,calc(100% - 24px));display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:8px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(20,20,60,.06)}
.nav .lg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;line-height:1.1}.nav .lg small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);font-size:10.5px}
.nav .lg i{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--g);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-style:normal;font-size:13px}
.nav ul{display:flex;gap:4px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 auto}.nav li a{font-size:12.5px;color:#4b5563;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:9px;transition:.2s}.nav li a:hover,.nav li a.on{background:#f1f0ff;color:var(--v)}
.nav .sr{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
section{position:relative;padding:92px 24px}.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:auto}
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding-top:110px}.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;width:100%}
.av{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:#374151;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:99px}.av:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#22c55e;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(34,197,94,.18);animation:pul 2s infinite}
@keyframes pul{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,0)}}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,7.4vw,84px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-weight:800;margin:20px 0 18px}.hero h1 span{display:block}
.hero p.l{max-width:470px;color:#4b5563;line-height:1.65;font-size:15.5px}
.btns{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin:26px 0 22px}.bk{background:#0b0b12;color:#fff;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;transition:.25s}.bk:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(11,11,18,.25)}.ln{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:#374151}
.soc{display:flex;gap:14px;color:#6b7280}.soc a{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;background:#fff;transition:.2s}.soc a:hover{color:var(--v);transform:translateY(-2px)}
/* lanyard + badge */
.lan{position:relative;height:520px;display:flex;justify-content:center}.lan .pv{position:absolute;top:-40px;left:50%;width:0;height:0}
.lan{perspective:1100px}.bd{transform-style:preserve-3d;position:absolute;top:-40px;left:50%;margin-left:-125px;width:250px;transform-origin:125px 0;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;user-select:none;will-change:transform}.bd:active{cursor:grabbing}
.strap{width:14px;height:96px;margin:0 auto;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1b1b25,#3a3a4a,#1b1b25);border-radius:3px}.clip{width:34px;height:14px;margin:-2px auto 0;background:linear-gradient(#cfd3dc,#8d93a3);border-radius:4px 4px 8px 8px}
.card{transform:rotateY(var(--by,0deg));margin-top:-2px;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -18px rgba(40,30,110,.35),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.04);overflow:hidden}
.card .ph{height:104px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed 0%,#a78bfa 45%,#fff 100%);position:relative;display:grid;place-items:end center}.card .ph svg{width:84px;height:84px;margin-bottom:-26px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #fff;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.card .bo{padding:34px 18px 16px;text-align:center}.card h3{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.01em}.card .rl{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px}
.card .gr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px 8px;text-align:left;margin:14px 0;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.card .gr small{display:block;font-size:8.5px;color:#9ca3af;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.card .gr b{font-size:11px}.ok{color:#16a34a}
.spk{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:28px;margin-top:6px}.spk i{flex:1;background:linear-gradient(#a78bfa,#7c3aed);border-radius:2px;animation:sp 2.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes sp{from{transform:scaleY(.55)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}.spk i{transform-origin:bottom}
.card .ft{font-size:9px;color:#9ca3af;margin-top:8px;text-align:left;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
/* marquee */
.mq{padding:26px 0;border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);overflow:hidden}.mq div{display:flex;gap:34px;width:max-content;animation:mq 34s linear infinite}.mq span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#374151}.mq i{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:10px;color:#fff}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.ab .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:50px;align-items:center}.ab h2,.hd h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,46px);letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}.ab p{margin-top:16px;color:#4b5563;line-height:1.7;font-size:14.5px}
.st{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.st div{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(20,20,60,.04);transition:.3s}.st div:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(124,58,237,.12)}.st b{display:block;font-size:34px;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:12px}.st small{color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}.st em{font-style:normal;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;background:#f3f0ff;color:var(--v);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px}
.hd{text-align:center;margin-bottom:42px}.hd p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;margin-top:10px}
.wid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;isolation:isolate}.blob{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:240px;height:240px;margin:-120px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#4f9dff,rgba(79,157,255,0) 68%);filter:blur(14px);opacity:.0;transition:opacity .3s;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}.wid:hover .blob{opacity:.75}
.wc{background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;min-height:150px;transition:transform .3s}.wc:hover{translate:0 -4px}.wc i{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:13px;color:var(--v)}.wc h4{margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:15px}.wc p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.6}
.sw{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:240px;gap:18px}.sw a{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -14px rgba(10,10,40,.45);isolation:isolate;transition:transform .4s}.sw a:hover{translate:0 -6px}.sw a:nth-child(3){grid-column:1}.sw svg.art{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:-1;transition:transform .8s}.sw a:hover svg.art{transform:scale(1.07)}
.sw .cp{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:44px 20px 18px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.72));display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px}.sw h4{font-size:16px}.sw small{opacity:.75;font-size:11.5px}.sw b{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#111;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;transition:.3s}.sw a:hover b{transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.tl{position:relative;max-width:860px;margin:auto}.tl:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(#c4b5fd,#7c3aed 60%,#e5e7eb);transform:translateX(-50%)}.tl .pg{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:2px;background:#7c3aed;transform:translateX(-50%);height:0;box-shadow:0 0 16px #7c3aed}
.ti{position:relative;width:50%;padding:0 38px 34px 0}.ti:nth-child(even){margin-left:50%;padding:0 0 34px 38px}.ti:before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-7px;top:22px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:3px solid #7c3aed;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(124,58,237,.12)}.ti:nth-child(even):before{right:auto;left:-7px}
.tc{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(20,20,60,.05)}.tc small{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--v);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}.tc h4{font-size:15px;margin:6px 0 2px}.tc em{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}.tc p{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#4b5563;margin-top:8px}
.ac{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;max-width:960px;margin:0 auto 46px}.ac .tc li{font-size:12.5px;color:#4b5563;margin:8px 0 0 16px;line-height:1.5}
.sk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:18px;max-width:960px;margin:auto}.sk h5{font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:14px}.bar{margin:12px 0}.bar div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px}.bar s{display:block;height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#eef0f6;overflow:hidden;text-decoration:none}.bar s i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a78bfa,#7c3aed,#22d3ee);transition:width 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.chips span{font-size:11.5px;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:600}
.ts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;max-width:1000px;margin:auto}.ts .tc{position:relative}.ts .q{position:absolute;right:18px;top:12px;font-size:34px;color:#1a1a24;font-family:Georgia,serif}.ts .who{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:16px}.ts .who i{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#fff}.ts .who b{font-size:12.5px;display:block}.ts .who small{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mut);letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400}
.ct{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:46px;max-width:960px;margin:auto;align-items:start}.ct h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.2vw,44px);letter-spacing:-.035em}.ct form{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px;display:grid;gap:12px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(20,20,60,.07)}.ct input,.ct textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:13.5px;background:#fafbff;outline:none;transition:.2s;font-family:inherit}.ct input:focus,.ct textarea:focus{border-color:#a78bfa;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(124,58,237,.12)}.ct button{background:#0b0b12;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}.ct button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.ok2{color:#16a34a;font-size:13px;min-height:18px}
.big{font-size:clamp(46px,13vw,170px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.05em;text-align:center;color:#f1f2f8;line-height:1;padding:30px 0 70px;user-select:none}
.dock{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:16px;transform:translate(-50%,90px);z-index:50;display:flex;gap:4px;background:rgba(11,11,18,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);padding:6px;border-radius:99px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.28);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.dock.on{transform:translate(-50%,0)}.dock a{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#cbd0dc;font-size:14px;transition:.2s}.dock a:hover,.dock a.on{background:#fff;color:#111;transform:translateY(-4px)}
@media(max-width:820px){.hero .wrap,.ab .wrap,.ct,.sk{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wid,.ts{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sw{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-auto-rows:210px}.ac{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lan{height:470px;order:-1}.nav ul{display:none}.tl:before,.tl .pg{left:14px}.ti,.ti:nth-child(even){width:100%;margin-left:0;padding:0 0 28px 40px}.ti:before,.ti:nth-child(even):before{left:8px;right:auto}.hero{padding-top:84px}}`;

const CSS_S=`:root{--bg:#07080a;--gold:#e3c15a;--or:#ff7a1a;--tx:#e9e6df;--mu:#8d8a82;--ln:rgba(227,193,90,.28)}
body{font-family:"Bahnschrift","Rajdhani","Chakra Petch","Arial Narrow",Impact,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);overflow-x:hidden;letter-spacing:.02em}

.hud nav{display:flex;gap:22px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:6px}.hud nav a{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#b9b6ad;transition:.2s}.hud nav a:hover,.hud nav a.on{color:#fff}.hud nav a.on{text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(227,193,90,.7)}

section{position:relative;padding:120px 6vw}.lbl{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.28em;color:var(--mu);text-transform:uppercase}

/* 01 line-up */
.s1{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding-bottom:70px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.echo{position:relative;font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,64px);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px}.echo .ec{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(227,193,90,.75);transform:translateY(calc(var(--e,8px)*var(--i)));opacity:calc(.62 - var(--i)*.13)}
.s1 .ph{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:#140a02 url(${IMG.fist}) 70% 40%/cover no-repeat;filter:saturate(1.15) contrast(1.1);transform:scale(1.08);animation:kb 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes kb{to{transform:scale(1.18) translate(-1.5%,1%)}}
.s1:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(7,8,10,.92),rgba(7,8,10,.25) 60%,rgba(7,8,10,.55)),radial-gradient(60% 70% at 78% 40%,rgba(255,122,26,.28),transparent)}
.s1 h1{font-size:clamp(54px,12.5vw,190px)}.s1 h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold);display:block}
.s1 .lbl{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--gold)}.s1 p.l{max-width:420px;margin-top:20px;color:#c8c4ba;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.03em;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
.scr{margin-top:34px;position:relative;height:38px;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);cursor:ew-resize;touch-action:none}.scr i{position:absolute;top:0;width:1px;height:8px;background:var(--ln)}.scr i.m{height:16px;background:var(--gold)}.scr b{position:absolute;top:-1px;width:2px;height:30px;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--gold);left:0}.scr span{position:absolute;right:0;top:20px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--mu)}
/* 02 spec */
.s2{min-height:92vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:4vw;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.s2 .ph{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:url(${IMG.patty}) 100% 100%/cover;opacity:.45;filter:saturate(1.25)}.s2:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bg) 30%,rgba(7,8,10,.35))}
.s2 h2{font-size:clamp(38px,6.6vw,92px)}.s2 h2 span{color:var(--gold)}
.temp{font-size:clamp(54px,9vw,128px);color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;margin:22px 0 6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(227,193,90,.25)}.temp sup{font-size:.4em;vertical-align:top;margin-left:4px}
.s2 p{max-width:430px;color:#bdb9ae;line-height:1.6;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14.5px}
.ptch{border:1px solid var(--ln);background:rgba(10,10,12,.7);padding:22px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}.ptch .rw{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--mu)}.ptch .rw b{color:var(--tx)}.ptch .rw:last-child{border:0}
/* 03 smash */
.s3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5vw;align-items:center}.s3 h2{font-size:clamp(46px,9vw,130px)}.s3 h2 span{color:var(--gold);display:block}
.s3 .im{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;max-height:640px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--ln)}.s3 .im img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s;filter:contrast(1.08) saturate(1.15)}.s3 .im:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}.s3 .im:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 60%,rgba(0,0,0,.6))}
.s3 .im:before{content:"CAM 02 · 1/250 · f2.8";position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gold);z-index:2}
.s3 p{max-width:440px;margin-top:22px;color:#c8c4ba;line-height:1.6;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px}
.nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);margin-top:46px}.nums div{padding:22px 16px 0 0}.nums b{display:block;font-size:clamp(40px,5.2vw,78px);color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.nums small{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--mu);margin-top:4px}.nums em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:11px;color:#a29f96;margin-top:8px;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.4}
/* 04 sear (scroll-driven) */
.s4{height:260vh;padding:0}.s4 .stk{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 6vw}
.s4 .fire{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(80% 60% at 70% 110%,rgba(255,90,10,calc(var(--p,0)*.8)),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(50% 40% at 30% 100%,rgba(255,180,30,calc(var(--p,0)*.5)),transparent 70%),linear-gradient(#08090c,#0d0908)}
.s4 .fl{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46%;opacity:calc(var(--p,0)*1.1);background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,110,20,.55) 0 6px,transparent 6px 22px);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(transparent,#000);mask:linear-gradient(transparent,#000);animation:fk 1.1s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes fk{50%{transform:translateY(-6px) scaleY(1.06);filter:brightness(1.3)}}
.s4 h2{font-size:clamp(40px,8vw,120px);position:relative}.s4 .lbl{color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:14px;position:relative}.s4 .st{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.26em;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:10px;position:relative}
.dg{position:absolute;right:7vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);display:flex;gap:26px;align-items:center}.dg b{font-size:clamp(70px,13vw,190px);color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--gold);font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1}.dg small{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--mu)}
.th{width:14px;height:240px;border:1px solid var(--ln);position:relative}.th i{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:calc(var(--p,0)*100%);background:linear-gradient(#ff3b1f,#ff9a1a);box-shadow:0 0 20px #ff5a1f}
/* 05 build */
.s5 h2{font-size:clamp(34px,6vw,84px);margin:10px 0 34px}.s5 h2 span{color:var(--gold)}
.bd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4vw;align-items:center}.stack{height:340px;display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:3px;border:1px solid var(--ln);padding:20px;background:radial-gradient(60% 50% at 50% 70%,rgba(255,122,26,.18),transparent)}
.stack i{display:block;height:var(--h,20px);width:var(--w,200px);border-radius:var(--r,10px);background:var(--c);transition:.5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);animation:drop .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) backwards}@keyframes drop{from{transform:translateY(-60px);opacity:0}}
.opt{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:8px 0 22px}.opt button{background:0;border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--tx);padding:10px 16px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}.opt button:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}.opt button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--gold);color:#111;border-color:var(--gold)}
.tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding-top:16px;margin-top:6px}.tot b{font-size:46px;color:var(--gold);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.tot small{color:var(--mu);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em}
/* 06 cut */
.s6 h2{font-size:clamp(34px,6vw,84px);margin-bottom:34px}.s6 h2 span{color:var(--gold)}
.col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);grid-auto-rows:170px;gap:12px}.col figure{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);grid-column:span 2}.col figure:nth-child(1){grid-column:span 3;grid-row:span 2}.col figure:nth-child(4){grid-column:span 3}.col img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:contrast(1.1) saturate(1.2);transition:transform 1s}.col figure:hover img{transform:scale(1.1)}
.col figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:30px 14px 12px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.85));font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--gold)}.col figcaption small{display:block;color:#cfcbbf;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
/* 07 story + reserve */
.s7 .cl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}.s7 .cl div{border:1px solid var(--ln);padding:0 0 22px;background:#0b0c0f}.s7 .cl .pic{height:190px;margin-bottom:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1410,#2b1b0f 50%,#0a0a0a);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.s7 .cl .pic:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-10%;right:-10%;bottom:-30%;height:80%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,122,26,.5),transparent)}
.s7 h3{font-size:24px;padding:0 20px}.s7 p{padding:8px 20px 0;color:#b4b0a6;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
.rs{text-align:center;padding-top:130px}.rs h2{font-size:clamp(44px,11vw,170px);background:linear-gradient(#fff 45%,#8a8a8a);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;position:relative;animation:sh 6s ease-in-out infinite}.rs h2 span{display:block;background:linear-gradient(var(--gold),#7a5f12);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
@keyframes sh{50%{filter:brightness(1.35)}}
.fm{max-width:640px;margin:40px auto 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;text-align:left}.fm label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--mu);display:block;margin-bottom:6px}.fm input,.fm select{width:100%;background:#0d0e11;border:1px solid var(--ln);padding:13px;color:var(--tx);outline:none;border-radius:0}.fm input:focus,.fm select:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.gs{display:flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:#0d0e11;height:46px}.gs button{width:46px;height:100%;background:0;border:0;color:var(--gold);font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}.gs b{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em}
.go{grid-column:1/-1;background:var(--gold);color:#111;border:0;padding:16px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}.go:hover{box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(227,193,90,.5);transform:translateY(-2px)}.cf{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:var(--gold);min-height:20px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em}
footer{padding:40px 6vw 60px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--mu)}
@media(max-width:860px){.hud{grid-template-columns:1fr auto}.hud nav{display:none}.s2,.s3,.bd,.s7 .cl{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nums{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.col{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:150px}.col figure,.col figure:nth-child(n){grid-column:span 1;grid-row:span 1}.col figure:nth-child(1){grid-column:span 2}.dg{position:relative;right:auto;top:auto;transform:none;margin-top:24px}.s4 .stk{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center}.fm{grid-template-columns:1fr}.br{display:none}}`;

const cardH=(c,i,cls)=>'<div class="'+cls+'" data-n="'+esc(c[0])+'" style="background:'+c[1]+'">'+c[2]+'</div>';
const CSS_A=`:root{--o:#ff4a1a;--bg:#f4f4f1;--k:#0a0a0a;--serif:"Cormorant Garamond","Instrument Serif","Playfair Display",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;--sans:"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,system-ui,sans-serif}
body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--k);overflow-x:hidden}
.top{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:50;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:16px 22px;pointer-events:none}.top>*{pointer-events:auto}
.top .dot{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#666,#000)}.top .r{display:flex;gap:6px}.top a,.top button{border:0;border-radius:99px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}.top .lt{background:var(--o);color:#fff}.top .mn{background:#0a0a0a;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18)}.top a:hover,.top button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.track{position:relative;height:620vh}
.stage{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;min-height:560px;overflow:hidden;perspective:1200px;background:var(--bg)}
.w{position:absolute;font:400 clamp(34px,5.6vw,78px)/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.03em;white-space:nowrap;z-index:1}.w1{left:14%;top:36%}.w2{right:14%;top:56%}.w span{display:inline-block}
.cs{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;z-index:2}
.cd{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:190px;height:118px;margin:-59px 0 0 -95px;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.28);will-change:transform,opacity;cursor:pointer;opacity:0}.cd:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent 40%);pointer-events:none}
.cd.on{outline:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #000,0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.lb{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:11px;color:#6a6a66;opacity:0}.lb b{color:#0a0a0a;font-weight:600}.lb .sf{background:#0a0a0a;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:99px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.ft1{position:absolute;left:22px;bottom:20px;font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.5;color:#7a7a76;max-width:260px;z-index:3}.ft2{position:absolute;right:22px;bottom:18px;display:flex;gap:6px;z-index:3;align-items:center}.ft2 button{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e1e1dc;color:#444;border-radius:99px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:10.5px;cursor:pointer}.ft2 button:hover{background:#0a0a0a;color:#fff}.ft2 em{font-style:normal;font-size:10px;color:#8a8a84;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-right:6px}
.vg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 60% at 72% 46%,#16205a,transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40% 40% at 18% 92%,#240f3f,transparent);opacity:0}
.eb{position:absolute;left:6vw;top:56px;font-size:11px;color:#9aa3c4;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;z-index:4;opacity:0}.eb:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--o)}
.sd{position:absolute;right:6vw;top:56px;max-width:260px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#9aa3c4;z-index:4;opacity:0}
.tx{position:absolute;left:6vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font:500 clamp(28px,4.4vw,54px)/1.14 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.03em;max-width:min(820px,86vw);z-index:4;color:#fff;opacity:0}.tx span{opacity:.22;transition:opacity .3s}.tx span.on{opacity:1}
.sphw{position:absolute;right:-4vw;top:50%;width:min(760px,74vw);height:min(760px,74vw);margin-top:calc(min(760px,74vw)/-2);perspective:1300px;z-index:3;opacity:0}.tilt{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;will-change:transform}
.sc{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:124px;height:77px;margin:-38px 0 0 -62px;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;backface-visibility:hidden;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.pr{background:#070a18;color:#fff;padding:120px 6vw 120px}.pr h3{font:500 clamp(26px,3.6vw,44px)/1.1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-bottom:40px}.stp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:0;position:relative}.stp:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:9px;height:1px;background:#222a52}.stp .pg{position:absolute;left:0;top:9px;height:2px;background:var(--o);width:0;box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--o);transition:width 1.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.stp div{position:relative;padding-top:34px;padding-right:14px}.stp div:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:2px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:#070a18;border:2px solid #4a5390;transition:.5s}.stp div.on:before{background:var(--o);border-color:var(--o);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(255,74,26,.18)}.stp b{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--o);letter-spacing:.1em}.stp h4{font-size:17px;margin:6px 0}.stp p{font-size:12.5px;color:#9aa3c4;line-height:1.55}
.kp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:#1a2146;margin-top:70px;border:1px solid #1a2146}.kp div{background:#070a18;padding:26px}.kp b{font:500 clamp(32px,4.4vw,56px)/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.03em}.kp small{display:block;color:#9aa3c4;font-size:12px;margin-top:8px}
.cta{background:var(--bg);padding:110px 6vw 60px;text-align:center}.cta h3{font:400 clamp(38px,7vw,100px)/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.035em}.cta form{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}.cta input{border:1px solid #d5d5cf;background:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:13px 20px;min-width:260px;font-size:14px;outline:none}.cta input:focus{border-color:#0a0a0a}.cta button{background:var(--o);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:99px;padding:13px 24px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}.cta button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(255,74,26,.35)}.cta .ok{min-height:20px;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;color:#2a7a3a}.cta footer{margin-top:80px;font-size:11px;color:#8a8a84;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:820px){.w1{left:8%;top:32%}.w2{right:8%;top:58%}.sd{display:none}.sphw{opacity:.5}.tx{top:42%}.stp{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}.stp:before,.stp .pg{display:none}.stp div{padding:0 0 0 34px}.kp{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lb{font-size:10px}.ft1{display:none}}`;
function pageA(){
const words='Time is money. We build high-quality websites in just 24 hours — combining speed, reliability, and modern design. Trusted by hundreds of satisfied clients.'.split(' ').map(w=>'<span>'+w+'</span>').join(' ');
const N=40,sph=Array.from({length:N},(_,i)=>{const y=1-2*(i+.5)/N,ph=i*2.399963,th=Math.asin(y)*180/Math.PI,c=CARDS[i%12];return '<div class="sc" style="transform:rotateY('+(ph*180/Math.PI).toFixed(1)+'deg) rotateX('+(-th).toFixed(1)+'deg) translateZ(var(--R))"><div style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:190px;height:118px;transform:scale(.653);transform-origin:0 0;color:#fff;background:'+c[1]+'">'+c[2]+'</div></div>'}).join('');
const steps=[['HOUR 0','Brief','A 30-minute call. We lock goals, audience and the one metric that matters.'],['HOUR 6','Design','Layout, type and motion direction approved in a live review.'],['HOUR 12','Build','Responsive build with real content, forms and analytics wired in.'],['HOUR 20','Review','Accessibility, speed and cross-device QA — one revision round included.'],['HOUR 24','Launch','Domain, hosting and handover. Your site is live.']].map(s=>'<div><b>'+s[0]+'</b><h4>'+s[1]+'</h4><p>'+s[2]+'</p></div>').join('');
return `<div class="top"><i class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="r"><a class="lt" href="#cta">Let’s talk</a><button class="mn" id="mn" aria-expanded="false">Menu</button></div></div>
<div class="track" id="track"><section class="stage" id="stage" aria-label="Giới thiệu — cuộn để chạy cảnh 3D"><i class="vg" id="vg"></i><div class="w w1" id="w1">We design</div><div class="w w2" id="w2">Really fast</div><div class="cs" id="cs">${CARDS.map((c,i)=>cardH(c,i,'cd')).join('')}</div><div class="lb" id="lb"><span>↘ <b id="lbn">Visio Clara</b></span><span>Selected work · 12 sites shipped in 24 hours</span><button class="sf" onclick="window.scrollBy({top:innerHeight*1.4,behavior:'smooth'})">● See Full</button></div>
<div class="eb" id="eb">The Approach</div><div class="sd" id="sd">Why wait weeks for a site you could launch tomorrow? Our streamlined, senior-only process removes the waiting, not the craft.</div><div class="sphw" id="sphw" style="--R:clamp(170px,23vw,320px)"><div class="tilt" id="tilt">${sph}</div></div><h2 class="tx" id="tx">${words}</h2>
<div class="ft1" id="ft1">Quickform Studio — Hồ Chí Minh City.<br>Websites that look expensive and ship in a day. Linh Trần, 31, Creative Director.</div><div class="ft2" id="ft2"><em id="pc">SCROLL ↓</em><button onclick="document.getElementById('pr').scrollIntoView()">Process</button><button onclick="document.getElementById('cta').scrollIntoView()">Contact</button></div></section></div>
<section class="pr" id="pr"><h3 class="reveal">From brief to live<br>in 24 hours.</h3><div class="stp" id="stp"><i class="pg" id="spg"></i>${steps}</div><div class="kp"><div class="reveal"><b data-to="312">312</b><small>Sites launched in 24 hours</small></div><div class="reveal d1"><b data-to="98" data-suf="%">98%</b><small>Clients who rebooked a second build</small></div><div class="reveal d2"><b data-to="1">1</b><small>Round of revisions — included, always</small></div></div></section>
<section class="cta" id="cta"><h3 class="reveal">Ready when<br>you are.</h3><form id="cf"><input type="email" required placeholder="you@company.com" aria-label="Email"><button>Start my 24h build →</button></form><div class="ok" id="ok" role="status"></div><footer><span>Quickform Studio</span><span>hello@quickform.studio</span><span>© 2027 · Website template preview</span></footer></section>`}
const JS_A=`(function(){var d=document,$=function(s){return d.querySelector(s)};
var tr=$('#track'),st=$('#stage'),cs=[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('.cd')),lb=$('#lb'),lbn=$('#lbn'),tx=[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('#tx span')),W,H,px=0,py=0,cur=-1;
function sp(el){el.innerHTML=el.textContent.split('').map(function(c){return '<span>'+(c===' '?'&nbsp;':c)+'</span>'}).join('')}sp($('#w1'));sp($('#w2'));
var l1=[].slice.call($('#w1').children),l2=[].slice.call($('#w2').children);
function cl(x,a,b){return Math.max(a===undefined?0:a,Math.min(b===undefined?1:b,x))}function ez(x){return x<.5?4*x*x*x:1-Math.pow(-2*x+2,3)/2}function lp(a,b,k){return a+(b-a)*k}
function mix(a,b,k){return 'rgb('+a.map(function(v,i){return Math.round(lp(v,b[i],k))}).join(',')+')'}
function lay(t){W=st.clientWidth;H=st.clientHeight;
var a=cl(t/.1),b=cl((t-.06)/.3),c=cl((t-.32)/.2),dd=cl((t-.58)/.22),dk=cl((t-.6)/.16),tf=1-cl((t-.3)/.08);
[l1,l2].forEach(function(L,j){L.forEach(function(s,i){var p=cl(a*1.7-(i*.07)-j*.25);s.style.opacity=p*tf;s.style.filter='blur('+((1-p)*7).toFixed(1)+'px)'})});
var gw=Math.min(780,W*.88),cw=(gw-30)/4,ch=cw*118/190,gs=cw/190,ofs=-1.1+b*1.55,fd=ez(dd);
cs.forEach(function(el,i){var u=ofs+i*.072,ux=cl(u,-.15,1.15),uc=cl(ux,0,1),sn=Math.sin(uc*Math.PI);
var rx=(ux-.5)*W*1.2,ry=H*(.24-ux*.46)-sn*H*.07,rz=-13,rr=(.5-ux)*46,rs=.85+.45*sn,ro=cl(u*7)*cl((1.12-u)*7);if(b>=1)ro=cl(ux*5)*cl((1.15-ux)*5);
var gx=((i%4)-1.5)*(cw+10),gy=(Math.floor(i/4)-1)*(ch+10)+H*.05,k=ez(cl(c*1.4-i*.035));
var x=lp(rx,gx,k),y=lp(ry,gy,k),z=lp(rz,0,k),ry2=lp(rr,0,k),s=lp(rs,gs,k),o=lp(ro,1,k),zz=sn*60*(1-k);
x*=1+fd*1.5;y*=1+fd*1.5;zz+=fd*1100;o*=1-cl(fd*1.5);
el.style.opacity=o.toFixed(3);el.style.transform='translate3d('+x.toFixed(1)+'px,'+y.toFixed(1)+'px,'+zz.toFixed(0)+'px) rotateY('+(ry2+fd*40*((i%4)-1.5)).toFixed(1)+'deg) rotateX('+(fd*-30).toFixed(1)+'deg) rotateZ('+z.toFixed(1)+'deg) scale('+s.toFixed(3)+')';el.style.zIndex=i;el.style.pointerEvents=o>.5?'auto':'none'});
lb.style.opacity=cl((t-.46)/.06)*(1-cl((t-.58)/.05));lb.style.width=gw+'px';lb.style.top=(H/2+H*.05-1.5*(ch+10)-34)+'px';
st.style.background=mix([244,244,241],[7,10,24],dk);$('#vg').style.opacity=dk;
var o2=cl((t-.66)/.08);$('#eb').style.opacity=o2;$('#sd').style.opacity=o2;$('#tx').style.opacity=cl((t-.7)/.06);
var sw=$('#sphw');sw.style.opacity=cl((dd-.25)/.6);$('#tilt').style.transform='scale('+lp(.45,1,ez(cl(dd*1.1)))+') rotateX('+(8+py*14)+'deg) rotateY('+(t*620+px*20)+'deg)';
var wn=cl((t-.8)/.17)*tx.length;tx.forEach(function(s,i){s.classList.toggle('on',i<wn)});
[$('#ft1')].forEach(function(e){e.style.opacity=1-dk});$('#ft2').style.opacity=1;$('#pc').textContent=t<.04?'SCROLL ↓':Math.round(t*100)+'%';
var nv=$('.top .dot');nv.style.background=dk>.5?'radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff,#9aa3c4)':'radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#666,#000)'}
function sc(){var r=tr.getBoundingClientRect(),t=cl(-r.top/(r.height-innerHeight));if(Math.abs(t-cur)>.0004){cur=t;lay(t)}}
var tick=false;addEventListener('scroll',function(){if(!tick){tick=true;requestAnimationFrame(function(){tick=false;sc()})}},{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',function(){cur=-1;sc()});sc();
cs.forEach(function(el){el.addEventListener('pointerenter',function(){cs.forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});el.classList.add('on');lbn.textContent=el.dataset.n})});
st.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){px=(e.clientX/innerWidth-.5)*2;py=(e.clientY/innerHeight-.5)*2;cur=-1;sc()});
var stp=$('#stp'),stepsEl=[].slice.call(stp.children).filter(function(e){return e.tagName==='DIV'});
